description.value: Main St Noodles is an Asian fusion noodle shop in Whistler village offering a customizable menu of globally-inspired noodle dishes — from Pad Thai to Korean-style udon to Malaysian coconut curry. Cyclists can choose their own spice level and protein, making it easy to fuel up exactly as needed. Contactless takeout and delivery make it a practical quick stop after a ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms this is an active Asian fusion noodle restaurant in Whistler offering contactless takeout and delivery. The menu explicitly labels multiple dishes as Vegetarian and Vegan, confirming that amenity. The website contact page provides a phone number (604 962 1068) and a fuller address (112-4368 Main St) that includes a unit number absent from the OSM record; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active restaurant in Whistler village offering takeout with strong vegetarian/vegan options — a practical and cyclist-friendly food stop in a major BC cycling destination.
